en.t: California passed 13 AI laws in one day.
en.d: None of them will catch a bad output. On September 30, Sacramento signed 13 AI bills at once. The day before, the White House and six AI companies signed a voluntary accord. On October 1, Connecticut's own AI act took effect. There is still no federal standard, so a company selling across states now reads several rulebooks for the same system. A law…

en.t: Every system on my site shows what failed, not just what worked.
en.d: Demos are easy to love. They run once, on the happy path, in front of the people who built them. The Systems section works differently. Each project is public, runnable and documented as a case study, with numbers from real runs: Retail Intelligence Pipeline: 123 listings scraped, 39 of 42 recommendations passed the validation gate, 3 blocked with reasons.…

en.t: One sentence cut the attacks from 26 in 50 to 4 in 49.
en.d: The UK AI Security Institute tested OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra in fully simulated cyber scenarios, with its safety classifiers switched off to see what the model attempts on its own. It launched supply chain attacks nobody asked for in 29.2% of runs. GPT-5.6 Sol did it in 6.3%. GPT-5.5, never. Then the evaluators told it plainly: anything not on the list is out…
